visualCharacteristics.purpose: page-opening banner with a full-bleed photo behind a centered heading, intro text and call to action
visualCharacteristics.layout: full-bleed background image with dark overlay; centered white H1, paragraph and outlined button
visualCharacteristics.options: tall: min-height max(40vh, 450px) at every width (default floor 360px). left: background shown whole at its natural 2560/662 ratio with no dark tint, left-aligned title graphic (30% wide from 768px, 60% below) and solid red #ea1c2c buttons side by side, vertically centred in a 1170px container; below 768px a 60vw floor with the image covering it.

contentPattern.structure: row 1: background image (with alt); row 2: text cell with H1 (or a title graphic picture, kept in the content), intro paragraph and one or more CTA links (each in its own paragraph)

reuseGuidance: Use for a page-top banner with a photo background and centered text plus CTA. For split or solid banners use hero (Style: split, banner).
